decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location Plan, 001 and 002 received 23/03/2011 and emails received 12/04/2011 and 14/05/2011)  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings to the minimum extent possible.

Condition : 4 - In the case of intervention in original walls, nib and/or downstands shall be retained to show the historical past of the building. Supporting beams shall be retained, and if changed because of rot, shall remain visible as a downstand. The nib shall have a minimum depth of 0.2m.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until details of the proposed doorway to the proposed ground floor cloakroom have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the works shall be carried out in accordance with these details unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority beforehand.

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until details of the proposed extract system from the relocated kitchen have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the works shall be carried out in accordance with these details unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority beforehand.
description: Listed building consent for the replacement of bathroom window with new window to first floor level and internal alterations including moving the location of the kitchen also alteration of internal doorways, moving walls to change room layouts.
